company.name: DataHub
company.shortDescription: DataHub is an open-source metadata platform that unifies data discovery, observability, and governance for AI and data ecosystems.
company.description: Datahub is an open-source data catalog that enables teams to discover and manage their data assets effectively. It provides access to a wide range of datasets, allowing users to leverage data for informed decision-making. The platform facilitates data governance, ensuring that organizations can maintain compliance and data quality. Additionally, Datahub supports integration with AI initiatives, helping technical teams streamline their data workflows and enhance productivity. By offering tools for data exploration and collaboration, Datahub empowers sales teams and representatives to access valuable insights that drive business growth.
